question: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2022 is awarded to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Svante Paabo.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2022** is awarded to **Svante Paabo.**
 
• He is a Swedish biologist who is known for his work in the field of** evolutionary genetics. **
 
• He is the director of the **Department of Genetics at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology** in Germany.
 
• Paabo's research has focused on the** study of ancient DNA**, particularly that of Neanderthals and other extinct species of humans.
 
• He has also been involved in the development of **new technologies for sequencing DNA**, which has allowed for more accurate and detailed analysis of genetic information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Giorgia Meloni** is a politician from Italy who is currently the leader of the political party** Fratelli d'Italia.**
 
• **Ales Bialiatski** is a human rights activist from **Belarus** who has been recognized for his work by **various international organizations.**
 
• **Valeri Polyakov **is a **retired Russian cosmonaut** who holds the record for the** longest single stay **in space by a human.
